item.text: I found the unsafe paths in the domain services: issue writes accept arbitrary label, parent, and assignee IDs; project writes accept any lead ID; comment replies and client-supplied mention IDs are also trusted. I’m adding scoped lookups before writes, and tightening label reads so cross-workspace attachments never render.
